datasets: Application dataset (100 images from worksheets and stories)

outputs: transcreated images and culturally edited captions
culturally adapted images through transcreation pipelines involving captioning, editing, and retrieval

changes_made.explanation: Removed 'Machine Translation' as the paper focuses on image transcreation, not text translation. Removed image generation models and outputs since they're not NLG tasks. Kept only the NLG components (captioning and caption editing).

Changed answer from Yes to No because the paper uses image similarity metrics (DINO-ViT, CLIP) to evaluate generated images, not traditional NLG metrics for text evaluation. These are computer vision metrics, not NLG evaluation metrics.
No LLMs are used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs are used for generation (caption editing) but not for evaluation of outputs.

guideline: Evaluators answer a questionnaire with Likert-scale questions (1-5) assessing visual change, semantic equivalence, spatial layout, cultural relevance, naturalness, offensiveness, and task suitability

changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria names to proper English and removed abbreviated forms. Consolidated duplicate criteria (C3 and E/S2 both refer to cultural relevance).

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on image transcreation (cultural adaptation of images) with NLG components (captioning and caption editing) as part of the pipeline. The main evaluation is human-centered with extensive criteria. The automatic metrics used are for image evaluation, not traditional NLG text evaluation metrics.
